title: Zero-leak valve from the ISS water-mist extinguisher
nasa_origin: A NASA-funded ISS water-mist extinguisher needed a valve that would stay sealed during storage.
earth_use: Doering commercialized the valve for industrial equipment and military trailer brakes.
benefit: NASA reported that the valve went into more than 450 munitions trailers.

title: Air-sampling fire detector
nasa_origin: The Brunswick Incipient Fire Detector was developed for Space Shuttle orbiters.
earth_use: Linked air-sampling sensors can monitor large spaces such as mines.
benefit: The detector distinguishes combustion particles from dust, reducing susceptibility to false alarms.

title: Lightweight firefighter air tanks
nasa_origin: NASA Johnson and Scott Aviation developed a composite tank with an aluminum liner.
earth_use: Scott Aviation used the tanks in a firefighter breathing-air backpack.
benefit: NASA reported 30 minutes of air in a 20-pound system, 13 pounds lighter than the conventional equipment it compared with.

title: FIRES firefighter protective clothing
nasa_origin: NASA and the U.S. Fire Administration drew on Apollo protective materials and design concepts.
earth_use: The FIRES project developed a protective ensemble and planned field feedback to inform standards.
benefit: The project aimed to improve heat protection for firefighters.
